summary: A Quote subscription on an index future (segment NFO, built from the OpenAlgo exchange, not the master's parent brexchange NSE): open interest and its change, then a partial packet whose OI 0 keeps the last OI.

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.
indmoney_adapter.py:316-327: the instrument is NFO:<token> even though brexchange is NSE.
